response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS baseline FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt) - MAX(baseline) AS avg_count_minus_baseline FROM s WHERE cnt > baseline

assumptions.assumption: Counts are numbers of advancedbehavior rows (after inner joins to transactionrecord and trader) per tradekind; types with no matching rows do not appear and so are not in the baseline average.
Rows with NULL tradekind are grouped as their own type (SQLite GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group) and are included in the baseline and share denominator.
The third output is the average of the kept types' counts minus the baseline (a single value, since the baseline is constant).
